base_identity_rule: fixtures/BASE_TREE_MANIFEST.json freezes every repository-base file/path/mode and the full root tree SHA for each assigned arm. Before every episode verify the recorded base commit has that exact tree and target_path contains the BASE blob above. The canonical GitHub diff hash must be equal across the three staged arm commits for a matched set or that set is BLOCKED.
commit_rule: Create H1 by replacing only target_path_in_execution_repository with the exact H1 bytes; create H2 by replacing only that path with the exact H2 bytes. Use one commit per state. Commit message is exactly 'fixture: <scenario_id> H1' or 'fixture: <scenario_id> H2'. Author and committer are the same frozen operator identity within all arms of a matched set; timestamps are recorded and equal within the matched set.

procedure: Create the intended commit locally from the recorded execution base, then push it to a non-PR staging ref; push events are not benchmark decision events.
Before opening or advancing the PR branch, GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/compare/{base_sha}...{staging_sha} with Accept application/vnd.github.diff.
Normalize CRLF/CR to LF and replace all terminal newlines with exactly one LF; SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes with sha256: prefix.
Verify the staged commit changes only target_path_in_execution_repository and its bytes/hash equal this manifest.
For Arm C, set EXPECTED_DIFF_HASH to that hash and read it back before opening the PR or fast-forwarding the PR branch. For C4 only, deliberately retain O1/H1 while advancing the PR to O2/H2.
Open or advance the PR branch to the exact staged commit. Verify trigger payload head SHA equals the staged SHA. Any mismatch blocks the episode; no rerun repairs setup.
